## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(table): add row selection`)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] Storybook stories added or updated (default, every variant, every state)
- [ ] Docs content updated in `src/docs/content.ts` (when to use, when not to, accessibility)
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader behaviour checked; `npm run test:a11y` passes
- [ ] Works in all 4 themes, light and dark, comfortable and compact
- [ ] Figma updated with **matching names** (component, variants, properties), or a follow-up issue is linked
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** (for user-facing changes)
